title: After the Satsuki Sho: Next Time for Sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Victory escapes Matikanetannhauser. Mihono Bourbon, who was also aiming to be Triple Crown champion, has her dreams shattered as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the Classic Triple Crown tour isn't over yet. Next up is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We slurp down some ramen and refocus our energy on the upcoming Japanese Derby!
